tribe.name: Ironshield Tribe
tribe.text: West of the ridge, the Ironshield have walled a cold valley and crowned a warden-captain. They do not raid for hunger — they raid for ground, and they keep what they take.

preliminaries.name: Break the Border Patrol
preliminaries.text: Their shield-lines walk the west road in pairs. Break them before they warn the keep.

preliminaries.name: Silence the Watch Post
preliminaries.text: A stone watch answers every horn. Blind it, and the stronghold fights half-asleep.

intel.army: Shield infantry, wall-breakers, and a muster that answers every horn
intel.tactics: Holds the yard behind stone; summons breakers when pressed
intel.weakness: Slow to turn — siege craft and armor-piercing steel pay double
intel.reward: Break the keep and its valley, road and stores join the Manner.

annex.name: Rebuild as an Outpost
annex.text: A fortified regional base: two more of every building line may stand.

annex.name: Dismantle for Materials
annex.text: Strip the keep stone by stone — timber, plate and cold coin for the Manner.

annex.name: Frontier Settlement
annex.text: The valley feeds the Manner: quicker gathering hands and one more of every line.

tribes.name: Thornband
tribes.text: In Whisperwood, the Thornband lace forest paths with snares. Raiders and fast scouts strike from the briars, then vanish beneath the trees.

preliminaries.name: Cut the Snare Lines
preliminaries.text: Clear the snared paths before the scouts carry your approach to the hold.

preliminaries.name: Burn the Briar Camp
preliminaries.text: Break the raiders at their forest camp and silence the warning fires.

intel.army: Forest raiders and fast scouts slipping between the briars
intel.tactics: Rushes the yard and summons raiders when pressed
intel.weakness: Hold narrow paths with pikes and overlapping tower fire
intel.reward: The Whisperwood paths, timber and stores join the Manner.

annex.name: Rebuild as an Outpost
annex.text: A fortified forest base: two more of every building line may stand.

annex.name: Dismantle for Materials
annex.text: Strip the briar hold for seasoned timber, plate and cold coin.

annex.name: Frontier Settlement
annex.text: Forest homesteads feed the Manner and open one more of every building line.
